What is the shortest path from node 1 to node 14? Represent the path as a list.

Options: 
A. [1, 2, 7, 8, 10, 9, 11, 14]
B. [1, 2, 5, 10, 6, 9, 11, 14]
C. [1, 3, 0, 4, 2, 6, 9, 11, 14]

F. [1, 3, 4, 0, 2, 5, 8, 10, 9, 11, 14]

I. [1, 0, 4, 3, 2, 7, 10, 9, 11, 14]
J. [1, 2, 6, 9, 11, 14]

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.
